rows.response_text: La Carreta is a Mexican restaurant located at 290 Storke Rd, Ste D, Goleta, CA. It is known for its shrimps which are well seasoned and plump, as well as its carne asada plate and chili verde. The restaurant does not offer Wi-Fi or music but it has outdoor seating and take-out service. It also accommodates groups. Despite the absence of valet, street, garage, and validated parking, there is a lot available for customers. The owner, Rosie, is commended for being helpful and nice. However, it is important to note that as per one of the reviews dated 2013, the restaurant has closed. Prior to its closure, the restaurant had an average rating of 4.0 stars.
